sentences.text: We use apps on our phones.
The apps are for photos and games.
We see our friends on apps.
But sometimes, phones are not fun.
The photos are of other people.
This can make us feel sad.
Sometimes, there are mean words on phones.
They make people feel very sad.
It is okay to feel sad.
It is good to take a break.
Play a game with your family.
Talk to your mom or dad.
A break from the phone is a good idea.
